correctness.rationale: Verified exact symmetric bilinear identity Q(s+d,s-d)=Q(s,s)-Q(d,d), simplex invariance, d(t)=exp(-t)d0 and product log derivative (1). Bounds |d_i|<=s_i and s_i>=m0 provide the explicit finite constants thetaD^2/(2m0); no hidden division at the boundary. Strict log-product concavity yields simple regular periodic levels. A transverse section constructs an action-angle chart and O(1+|t|) derivative bound, allowing inverse-flow integration of the O(exp(-2t)) perturbation and O((1+t)^2 exp(-2t)) phase tracking. The limiting central level has a nondegenerate Hessian, giving O(exp(-t)) convergence. The three polynomial identities were expanded symbolically at an actual package path, and no numerical run is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The source explicitly leaves non-diagonal initial data outside its periodicity theorem, a mathematically natural four-dimensional basin problem. The new exact quantitative positivity bound prevents heteroclinic extinction; its transformed conserved-product limit and phase estimate classify entire omega-limit sets for every collective-full-support initial condition, including sex-support mismatches. This is a motivated nonlinear stability and foliation result, not a trivial consequence of sex synchronization or a computational parameter slice. It identifies the sharp meaningful initial support boundary, though it does not treat behavior there.
